head.title: Residences - Addiction Rehab Centres Canada
headings: A Private, Comfortable Place to Recover

blocks.text: The journey to recovery is challenging enough, without having to worry about where you’ll be staying, how you’ll be treated, and whether you’ll be comfortable. We believe that addiction is a lifestyle disease, which means that supporting you in establishing a healthy lifestyle is vital as a way to support you on your journey to recovery. We offer comfortable, relaxing housing that can make your recovery journey just a bit easier.

blocks.text: For many addicts, a history of trauma or abuse figure prominently in the desire to use alcohol or drugs. We prioritize your safety and comfort above all else, because we know you can’t recover if you’re constantly wracked with anxiety. We offer a gated community that keeps you safe and protects your privacy. No one has to know you’re staying with us, and we have staff available 24/7 in case you need any additional help. No matter when temptation rears its ugly head, we’re here to help you weather the storm.
